dedupe_keys.name: philsa satellite imagery catalog stac api including diwata 2 smi level 1c

description: The Philippine Space Agency runs a satellite imagery catalogue built on the SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog specification, with a STAC Browser front end and a STAC API that supports item search with filters. The API lists three collections: Diwata-2 SMI Level 1C, with top-of-atmosphere reflectance images from the spaceborne multispectral imager of the Diwata-2 microsatellite from July 2019 to July 2021, processed during the STAMINA4Space programme of the University of the Philippines and the Department of Science and Technology, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0, with operations continued by PhilSA; and PlanetScope (August 2019 to May 2023) and SkySat (March to June 2023) collections under proprietary licences. The University of the Philippines is named as processor, producer and licensor of Diwata-2 data and PhilSA as host, and imagery can be previewed through a tile server. Access to the catalogue is free online. Caveats: the browser needs JavaScript, only the Diwata-2 collection has an open licence, and the commercial collections cover short periods. Coverage is the Philippines. It supports hazard exposure and post-disaster damage mapping of infrastructure after typhoons and floods; related records are the MYSA open data catalogue and the KGS space monitoring platform of Kazakhstan.
